column1: # Rotated-page geometry fixtures for the D18 rotation work (#1980, #1982).
# Read by Excise.Core.Tests/TestSupport/RotationFixtures.cs; verified against qpdf, Poppler
# (pdfinfo, pdftotext -bbox) and MuPDF (mutool draw -F stext) by
#   id                 stable id used by RotationScenarioTable
#   kind               corpus    = a gitignored corpus file, resolved through TestRepoLayout
#                      synthetic = built in memory by RotationProbes from the id
#   path               repo-relative corpus path (empty for synthetic)
#   sha256             full SHA-256 of the corpus file (empty for synthetic)
#   rotate_at          where /Rotate is written: leaf | parent | absent | parent+leaf
#   effective_rotation /Rotate after inheritance, as qpdf and Poppler resolve it
#   cropbox            llx lly urx ury (MediaBox when absent)
#   target             text whose region the interaction tests use; "-" when the page has
#   limitations        what the fixture cannot establish

column13: Odfjell Drilling presentation excerpt (Acrobat Distiller 8.1). The Type1 subset has no ToUnicode, so MuPDF and Poppler extract symbol garbage: usable for glyph geometry and markup placement, not for search or exact copied text. qpdf --check passes with a linearization hint-table warning.
Parklands Phase 14B land-survey excerpt, A0, re-saved by pdf-lib. One searchable header line; the rest is survey bearings. Zero CropBox origin, so it cannot exercise a cropped origin.
Omits /Rotate entirely: pins the ISO 32000-2 default of 0.
Helvetica (non-embedded): renderers substitute metrically compatible fonts.
/Rotate only on the /Pages node; the leaf inherits it.
/Pages says 270, the leaf overrides with an explicit 0 (#1981).
CropBox origin (90,250): visible page differs from the MediaBox.
Nonzero CropBox origin combined with a quarter turn.

Page turned 90 clockwise, text matrix turned 90 counter-clockwise, so the text reads upright on screen (the scanned-landscape shape). excise extraction splits such lines into single glyphs (#2008), so search cannot use it.
